exposure: timing of heart failure onset (prenatal vs. postpartum)
cohort: 70 pregnant women with heart failure at West China Second University Hospital between September 2012 and September 2017
finding: Peripartum heart failure is associated with high maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality, with hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, lung infections, and cardiac problems being the most common precipitating factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 95.71% of the pregnancies.
